title: Inspect the gravel 1× drivetrain
summary: Check the exposed chain, chainring, wide cassette and rear derailleur after mixed-surface riding.

steps.title: Inspect the chain
steps.instruction: Look for obvious rust, stiff or damaged links, severe contamination or abnormal routing before rotating the drivetrain.
steps.why: The chain is exposed directly to grit and water on mixed-surface rides.
steps.warning: Keep hands, cloth and loose clothing clear whenever the drivetrain is moving.
steps.check: No obvious chain damage or unsafe routing is visible.

steps.title: Inspect the sprockets
steps.instruction: Check the chainring and cassette for bent/damaged teeth, debris and signs of abnormal wear or impact.
steps.why: Damaged teeth or trapped debris can affect chain retention and shifting.
steps.warning: Do not diagnose replacement solely by tooth appearance; drivetrain wear must be assessed as a system.
steps.check: No obvious impact damage or trapped debris is present.

steps.title: Inspect derailleur alignment and movement
steps.instruction: Look for impact damage, a visibly twisted position, excessive looseness or obstruction, then shift through the available cassette in a controlled check.
steps.why: The rear derailleur is exposed to impact and must guide the chain precisely over a wide cassette.
steps.warning: Do not bend the derailleur or hanger by eye as a generic adjustment method.
steps.check: The derailleur shows no obvious impact damage and shifts predictably through the intended range.

steps.title: Route persistent shifting faults to the exact drivetrain
steps.instruction: If indexing, chain retention or range problems remain, identify the exact shifter, derailleur, cassette, chain and hanger system before adjustment.
steps.why: Cable pull/electronic actuation, sprocket count, capacity and adjustment procedures differ between drivetrain families.
steps.warning: Do not apply adjustment instructions from an unrelated drivetrain generation.
steps.check: Any unresolved shift fault is matched to the correct drivetrain-specific procedure.
